title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CHAIR, ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE, relative to funding an artificial turf study and the impacts of synthetic turf on…
text:
[Council File 24-0602-S1]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CHAIR, ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENT COMMITTEE, relative to funding an artificial turf study and the impacts of synthetic turf on recreational needs, climate, and plastic pollution.
Recommendation(s) for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Blumenfield – Yaroslavsky), SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. INSTRUCT the Department of Recreation and Parks (RAP), with the collaboration and assistance of the Department of Water and Power, Bureau of Sanitation, Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), and City Administrative Officer, to report to Council in 180 days with an analysis of the findings and recommendations in the study, taking into account recreational needs, climate realities, future funding, and plastics pollution proliferation from artificial turf, such as in ground water aquifers, soils, and storm drains.
2. TRANSFER/APPROPRIATE up to $330,000 from the AB 1290 Fund No. 53P, Account No. 281203 (CD 3) Redevelopment Projects - Services) to the RAP Fund No. 302/89, Account No. 89270K (General Capital), Subaccount Synthetic Field Study to fund the artificial/synthetic turf study.
3. AUTHORIZE the RAP to confirm the total funding amount of the study prior to the transfer of funds, and make any new corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above funding transfer instructions in order to implement Mayor and Council intentions.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the CLA has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Asks to fund a study of artificial turf and its effects on recreation needs, climate and plastic pollution.
